scope: Manual per-record reference-text semantic audit against canonical scenario/action. Official reference is offline evidence only; no listening or audio/reference alignment adjudication performed. Learning sources only. Accepted labels support a restricted training pilot, not an audited benchmark or full ontology approval. No entity-type labels reviewed.
